in_marathi.name: Kshirja
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Milk
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshirja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root kshir, meaning 'milk'. In Hindu mythology, Kshirja is the goddess of milk and prosperity. She is also known as Kshirabdi, representing abundance and wealth.

in_bengali.name: Kshirja
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Milk
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kshirja একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit root kshir, meaning 'milk'. In Hindu mythology, Kshirja is the goddess of milk and prosperity. She is also known as Kshirabdi, representing abundance and wealth.
